findings.description: The security group allows TCP/22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing SSH on the internet-facing instance to the entire internet and enabling brute-force or exploit attempts against the administrative interface.
The egress rule permits all protocols to 0.0.0.0/0, allowing a compromised host to reach arbitrary command-and-control endpoints and exfiltrate data with no network boundary.

The user_data script exports a static AWS access key ID and secret access key in cleartext. EC2 user data is retrievable via the instance metadata service (and by anyone with DescribeInstanceAttribute permission), leaking long-lived AWS credentials.

No metadata_options block is specified, so IMDSv1 remains enabled on an internet-facing web server; combined with credentials embedded in user_data this allows credential theft through a simple SSRF against 169.254.169.254/latest/user-data.
No root_block_device with encrypted = true is configured, so the root EBS volume is created unencrypted unless account-level EBS default encryption happens to be enabled.

The instance is launched in a subnet with map_public_ip_on_launch enabled and a 0.0.0.0/0 route to the internet gateway, placing the host directly on the public internet with no load balancer or bastion boundary in front of it.
The EBS data volume does not set encrypted = true and specifies no KMS key, so data written to the attached disk is stored unencrypted.
The snapshot is derived from an unencrypted EBS volume, so the snapshot data is also unencrypted and any accidental sharing or copy exposes plaintext data.

The VPC flow log destination bucket has no server-side encryption configuration (no aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration and no KMS key), so sensitive network telemetry is stored without customer-controlled encryption.

No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block or restrictive bucket policy is defined for the flow log bucket, leaving it dependent on account-level settings to prevent public exposure of network traffic metadata.
The bucket has no policy denying requests where aws:SecureTransport is false, so log data may be read or written over cleartext HTTP.
map_public_ip_on_launch = true means every instance launched in this internet-gateway-routed subnet automatically receives a public IP, removing the network boundary by default.
